title: 'everyone, …' in a people group: both agents answer once; a remark after that is silence

turns.prompt: everyone, in one line: what is 6 × 7?

rubric.criteria: The reply text shown is the two agents' bubbles joined (one line each is expected, so two lines with 42 is the PASS shape). Pass if both lane-a and lane-b answered with 42, each in one line; fail if only one answered, if one agent answered twice, or if one answered on behalf of the other.

regression: the judge's `all agents` verdict (everyone replies) and silence on the remark that follows ('task is done' woke Affine on 2026-10-27).
